notes: No corpus evidence is recorded, and none can be: the production matches the empty string, so no line of text is an instance of it in any way a reader could check.
decision: SysML 8.2.2.17.4 states this production as `EmptyUsage : ReferenceUsage = {}` — an empty right-hand side. The Xtext says the same in its own notation, `{SysML::ReferenceUsage}`, an object-creating action that consumes no input. Both derive the empty string, so the rule is an empty sequence. It is the usage that stands in an EmptyParameterMember, occupying a parameter position the concrete syntax leaves unwritten: it is what lets `send x to y`, which names no sender, build the same shape of model as `send x via s to y`.

evidence.note: States the production as `{}`; the rule is the empty sequence that transcribes it. The pack flags this clause as malformed, but the defect is in TriggerExpression (SYSML21-401) and not in this production.
Second opinion. `{SysML::ReferenceUsage}` consumes no input, so it agrees the production derives the empty string.
